title: dianthus furcatus subsp. subulatus
intro: Dianthus furcatus subsp. subulatus, commonly known as Fringed Pink or Pink Fringed Pink, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects on the nervous system.
